subject: Mutual action roadmap: SOC 2 evidence lane, SIG/CAIQ pass & DPA archival windows
messages:
From: Laura Milton <laura.milton@artemisbank.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@artemisbank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: evidence sequencing + DPA archival windows

Hi Soojin / Jonas,

Thanks for the intro. We’re ready to start a formal MAP for the pilot. Before we lock timelines I want to confirm two things up front so we can align with our security and procurement teams:

1) SOC 2 evidence sequencing — we need a clear list of which artifacts Redwood will provide versus what we must collect on our side. If you can call out expected delivery dates for each artifact that helps the SOC 2 unit plan.

2) DPA & data retention — Artemis requires a proposed archival/retention annex for the pilot (30/90/365 day options) and an initial redline of any DPA carveouts. Procurement will review but security wants the retention windows mapped to feature flags (hosted vs private).

Can you share a MAP spreadsheet with explicit gates (SIG/CAIQ pass, SOC 2 evidence, DPA sign-off) and an initial timeline for the next 6 weeks?

Laura
Laura Milton
CISO, Artemis Bank
security@artemisbank.com

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Milton <laura.milton@artemisbank.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: evidence sequencing + DPA archival windows

Laura — thanks, and great to be working with Artemis. I’m attaching a draft MAP and an evidence matrix to respond directly to your asks. High level summary below; full details are in the MAP_v1.xlsx (tabbed by gate).

Quick summary (6-week pilot cadence, tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP shared; SIG/CAIQ intake (security questionnaire) assigned to Redwood for initial pass.
- Week 1: Redwood delivers SOC 2 artifacts we can provide immediately (control descriptions, SOC 2 scope doc, encryption-at-rest/config snapshots). See SOC2_evidence_matrix.pdf for specifics.
- Weeks 2–3: Artemis completes environment-level items (customer-specific configs) + joint verification calls.
- Week 4: SIG/CAIQ review complete, SOC 2 evidence bucket validated.
- Week 5: DPA redlines reconciled; procurement reviews archival windows and signs off on the pilot DPA addendum.
- Week 6: Final acceptance and sign-off for pilot rollback/escape clauses.

On retention windows: we propose three pilot options (we included them as separate rows in the MAP): 30-day ephemeral (default hosted) / 90-day short-term (hosted with PII scrub) / 365-day (dedicated/private + escrow). Each option maps to the features you called out; we’ll mark which gates are required for each.

I’ve attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft timeline + gate owners), SOC2_evidence_matrix.pdf (what Redwood will supply vs what Artemis owns). Marissa will take lead on DPA redline coordination — she’s copied.

Next steps: quick sync with your security + procurement (30 min) — available Wed 12/2 or Thu 12/3. Which works for your team?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_evidence_matrix.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Milton <laura.milton@artemisbank.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: evidence sequencing + DPA archival windows

Laura — quick follow on from our side: two clarifications to speed procurement review

1) If Artemis wants the 365-day retention option we’ll require Dedicated or Private deployment for the pilot due to custody/residency controls — noted in the MAP under "Deployment dependency". If Procurement needs estimated delta pricing, I can surface a short cost note.

2) On DPA carveouts: Marissa, can you confirm which clauses in your redline draft trigger the need for KMS/HSM escrow or third-party audit rights? I flagged typical carveouts in the MAP comments, but we’ll want to be explicit so procurement can approve quickly.

Also — proposed sync for Wed 12/2 at 10:00am PT (30 mins). I’ll send a calendar invite once Laura confirms.

-Jonas
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks — Wed 12/2 10:00am PT works for the security & procurement leads (I adjusted on our side). We’re leaning toward the 90-day option for the pilot but will confirm after the call. Procurement also asked for an initial DPA redline (I attached a short note to procurement) — Marissa, please look for it.

One ask for the call: please have a slide that maps each MAP gate to the single owner (Redwood vs Artemis) and the expected document deliverable (artifact filename or link). That will make the SOC2 team’s life much easier.

See you Wed — Laura
